proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E F _ _ _ _ T M hM
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine T.opNorm_le_bound hM fun x => ?_
    refine NormedSpace.norm_le_dual_bound 𝕜 (T x) (by positivity) fun g => ?_
    calc ‖g (T x)‖ = ‖(g.comp T) x‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ ‖g.comp T‖ * ‖x‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ ≤ (M * ‖g‖) * ‖x‖ := by gcongr; exact h g
      _ = M * ‖x‖ * ‖g‖ := by ring
  · intro h g
    calc ‖g.comp T‖ ≤ ‖g‖ * ‖T‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖g‖ * M := by gcongr
      _ = M * ‖g‖ := mul_comm _ _
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] (T : E →L[𝕜] F) (M : ℝ), 0 ≤ M → ((∀ g : StrongDual 𝕜 F, ‖g.comp T‖ ≤ M * ‖g‖) ↔ ‖T‖ ≤ M)
